'''Lucen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during [[Alderaan Civil War|the planet's civil war]].
